svg.text: Cc 2 fF: M2-M3 metal fingers at the a0 tap
ls_ac: AC-coupled level shifter with duty-correcting feedback
a0 swings vg..VDD; Cc removes vg, INV1-3 restore the full rail (ls)
R1/C1 low-pass ls (tau ~0.16 us) back to lg through LRB: 3 inversions = negative DC feedback, so mean(ls) sits at INV1's trip point (duty ~50 %)
